propositions: A new plan-review criterion T15 overlay must be added to require proof of runtime-only correctness mechanisms via fast out-of-loop experiments before committing them into slow codified delivery loops.

T15 applicability is gated on three conditions: the mechanism is delivered through an automated pipeline, one pass through that loop is slow or costly, and correctness can only be resolved at runtime in a realistic environment.

T15 findings must include specific risk naming, a committed fast out-of-loop proof path (local/emulated or real-target experiment), proof occurring before codification, and cleanup scoped only to experiment artifacts.
T10's rubric must be partitioned with a scope clause explicitly excluding transient throwaway experiments from its durable-infrastructure evaluation.

The criterion must be discoverable via `rebar explain T15`, integrated into the plan-review criteria guide and writing-a-passing-plan guidance documents, and validated by existing registry validators.
